name: Raschke Anti: Stochastic(7,10,3) hook continuation, same-day exit
author: Linda Bradford Raschke (via RoboForex)
license: Source terms apply; paraphrased summary only
indicators: Stochastic 7,10,3 (fast K and slow D lines)
entry_long: Slow line of Stochastic(7,10,3) rising => only buys. Fast line pulls back against the slow line toward it without crossing, then hooks back in the slow line direction (both lines move same way): that candle is the signal candle. Enter when price breaks the signal candle high.
entry_short: Slow line falling; fast line rallies toward slow line, hooks down; enter on break of signal-candle low.
exit: Close by end of day if still open.
stop_loss: Below the signal-candle low (longs) / above its high (shorts)
position_sizing: Not specified by the source beyond its strategy() defaults; no sizing inferred.
filters: None beyond those listed in the entry rules.
implementation_notes: If fast line crosses slow line instead of hooking, skip. Day-end exit makes it an intraday system.
